competing_explanation: Restricting Feydy off-diagonal zero-distance clone deduplication to discrete zero-noise ParticlePrior codebooks via rhbi_self_coupling='feydy_discrete' could fail to recover quantized 4-bit precision_gaussian_nvfp4 (cdf_ks <= 0.05) if any non-Feydy path altered continuous MoG updates, or could disturb discrete image quality on img_blobs4/img_intensity2.
hypothesis: Binding Feydy off-diagonal zero-distance clone deduplication strictly to discrete zero-noise ParticlePrior codebooks via rhbi_self_coupling='feydy_discrete' (alongside rhbi_simplex_weight=0.35 and rhbi_cond_ot_mode='imq_cmmd', rhbi_cond_ot_weight=1.5) preserves full quantized empirical bin multiplicity on continuous-density MoG priors—restoring both stretch precision_gaussian_mxfp8 and precision_gaussian_nvfp4 (cdf_ks <= 0.05) to exact rhbi-v6 parity—while simultaneously retaining rhbi-v7's newly unlocked passes on img_blobs4 and img_intensity2 plus img_stripes2 and all 82/115 counted view requirements under one global clock-free, shape-gate-free recipe on protocol seed 0.
